description.message: Smoother video on computers without hardware decoding: video sites send H.264, and you get a notice when a video stutters. Set up in LordOS Settings.

stutter.message: This video is stuttering. A lower quality may play smoothly.

lowered.message: Quality lowered to $Q$ so the video plays smoothly.

lowerManual.message: Choose a lower quality in the player's settings.
